_comment: win/tty/topl.c tty_yn_function() Ctrl-P with msg_window:full, with a history window tall enough to cover map rows. After the recall, tty_clear_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE) finds the message window already empty and does nothing, so the map rows the dismissed window repaired stay drawn. A lawful dwarvish Valkyrie looks at the floor fourteen times, asks to pray, recalls the history, and declines with Escape. Independent of batch 5.
